notes: This experiment extends v1 without overwriting its tables.
Each impact model is fitted using bars strictly before the calendar-month boundary.
Residuals are contemporaneous errors on the same event bar as the decision clock.
The conditional z-score uses only the preceding three months and is robustly centred and scaled within side and scaled-pressure quintile.
Future returns begin at the completed bar endpoint; 30 seconds is the shortest observation horizon.
Buy and sell observations are reported separately as well as pooled.
A negative residual/future-return IC indicates mean reversion after excess impact.
